Guide for Claude Code (claude.ai/code) in this repo: modern enterprise-grade dotfiles. Supports macOS/Linux/WSL; progressive/tier-based config for shell, tmux, Neovim; performance optimizations; declarative tools; modular plugins.

Core CLI: `dot` in `bin/dot` orchestrates `lib/cli/`:
`core.sh` (setup/check/update), `ai.sh` (AI integration/code assistance), `security.sh` (security scanning/hardening), `project.sh` (project init/management), `testing.sh` (test execution/reporting).
Declarative: tools in `config/tools.yaml`. Profiles: minimal, standard, full, ai_focused. Platform detection: automatic OS/distro+package manager. Plugins: `plugins/core/`, `plugins/community/`, `plugins/local/` (template: `plugins/local/hello-world/`). Tiers: Tier 1=8 essential plugins; Tier 2=23; Tier 3=33+.
Neovim entry: `config/nvim/init.lua`, core: `config/nvim/lua/core/`, tiers: `config/nvim/lua/tiers/`, langs: `config/nvim/lua/languages/`.
Tmux: `config/tmux/tmux.conf` + `config/tmux/core.conf` (essential bindings: Ctrl-a prefix, hjkl navigation, | and - for splits).
Zsh: `config/zsh/` modular; performance modes fast (<300ms), balanced (<500ms), full (<1000ms); auto-detect resources; autosuggestions/history.
Keybindings streamlined to 10 essential via tier system.

Install/test commands to run exactly:
./install.sh install standard
./install.sh in
